paper.citation: Nern et al., 2025, Nature 641(8065): 1225-1237, Connectome-driven neural inventory of a complete visual system

quotes_from_main_text.n_types: We classified around 53,000 visual system neurons into 732 cell types
quotes_from_main_text.vcn: We identified 104 VCN types across about 270 cells
quotes_from_main_text.concentration: The number of neurons that constitute a type varied widely, with 60 cell types accounting for >50% of the synaptic connections and about 75% of the neurons.

vfb_side.linked_to_paper_by: 知識庫裡 DataSet 的 has_reference 關係指向 FBrf0262545

note: 正文說 732 cell types、around 53,000 neurons；這張表算出來是 732 個型、52,827 顆——兩者對得起來，所以這張表可以當靶。PART 8 的比對就是拿 VFB 的資料跟 target 這一段逐列比。
